title: Held-out English comprehension eval S, NEW question kinds (48 examples, 6 families)
note: HELD-OUT EVAL ONLY. Never use for training. Six NEW families not in the training bank, R3 or R5 (superlative_extreme, what_changed_state, sum_of_two_quantities, possession_transfer_result, passive_who_did_to_whom, exclusion_only_except). Same answer-key policy as NEW-KINDS-R5.json (mechanical normalization, then exact match against accepted_answers; yes_no accepts only Yes/No). Expose only source_text or paraphrase plus question strings to the learner.

examples.source_text: Orlin is taller than Brisa, and Brisa is taller than Hobart.
examples.paraphrase: Hobart is shorter than Brisa, who is shorter than Orlin.

examples.source_text: Ysolde beat Wendel to the finish, and Fenwick came in behind them both.
examples.paraphrase: Both Ysolde and Wendel finished ahead of Fenwick, with Ysolde in front of Wendel.

examples.source_text: Ansel is two years older than Greta, and Greta is older than Lucan.
examples.paraphrase: Lucan is younger than Greta, and Greta is two years younger than Ansel.

examples.source_text: Odalys's pumpkin outweighs Perrin's, but Sorrel's outweighs them both.
examples.paraphrase: Sorrel grew a pumpkin heavier than both Odalys's and Perrin's, and Perrin's weighs less than Odalys's.

questions.question: Is Perrin's pumpkin lighter than Sorrel's?

examples.source_text: Thaddeus saved more money than Ulrik, but less than Vesna.
examples.paraphrase: Vesna saved more than Thaddeus, who saved more than Ulrik.

examples.source_text: Zephyr's stack of blocks was shorter than Beatrix's, and Caspar's was shorter than Zephyr's.
examples.paraphrase: Beatrix's stack stood higher than Zephyr's, which stood higher than Caspar's.

questions.question: Was Caspar's stack taller than Zephyr's?

examples.source_text: Elspeth's gong rang louder than Florin's but quieter than Dorian's.
examples.paraphrase: Florin's gong was quieter than Elspeth's, and Dorian's was louder than hers.

questions.question: Was Florin's gong louder than Elspeth's?

examples.source_text: Jasper paid less for his cloak than Kestrel did, and Leopold paid more than Kestrel.
examples.paraphrase: Kestrel paid more for a cloak than Jasper, but less than Leopold.

examples.source_text: At dawn the pond was frozen; by noon it had melted.
examples.paraphrase: The pond had melted by noon, although at dawn it was frozen.

questions.question: How was the pond at dawn?
Was the pond still frozen at noon?

examples.source_text: Before the storm Marguerite's gate was painted yellow; afterwards it was bare.
examples.paraphrase: The storm left Marguerite's gate bare; earlier it had been painted yellow.

questions.question: What was the gate like after the storm?
Was the gate yellow before the storm?

examples.source_text: Tobias's barrel held rainwater on Monday and was empty by Friday.
examples.paraphrase: By Friday Tobias's barrel was empty, though on Monday it held rainwater.

questions.question: What did the barrel hold on Monday?
Was the barrel full on Friday?

examples.source_text: Ingrid's sapling was knee-high last spring and is now taller than the fence.
examples.paraphrase: The fence is now shorter than Ingrid's sapling, which was only knee-high last spring.

questions.question: How tall was the sapling last spring?
Is the sapling taller than the fence now?

examples.source_text: Cormac's kayak was dented before the trip and undamaged after the repair.
examples.paraphrase: After the repair Cormac's kayak was undamaged; before the trip it had been dented.

questions.question: What was the kayak's condition after the repair?
Was the kayak dented before the trip?

examples.source_text: The fountain ran dry in August and was flowing again by October.
examples.paraphrase: By October the fountain was flowing again, after running dry in August.

questions.question: What was the fountain doing in October?
Was the fountain flowing in August?

examples.source_text: The cabin door was latched when Nadine arrived and unlatched when she left.
examples.paraphrase: When Nadine left, the cabin door was unlatched; on her arrival it had been latched.

questions.question: What state was the door in when Nadine left?
Was the door unlatched when Nadine arrived?

examples.source_text: The lawn was yellow in July; after the August rains it was lush.
examples.paraphrase: After the August rains the lawn was lush, whereas in July it had been yellow.

questions.question: How was the lawn after the rains?
Is the lawn lush after the rains?

examples.source_text: Petra caught three trout and Rafferty caught four.
examples.paraphrase: Rafferty's catch was four trout, and Petra's was three.

questions.question: How many trout did they catch altogether?
Did they catch more than six trout in all?

examples.source_text: Selwyn has two sisters and three brothers.
examples.paraphrase: Selwyn's siblings are three brothers and two sisters.

questions.question: How many siblings does Selwyn have?
Does Selwyn have exactly four siblings?

examples.source_text: Tamsin read six pages in the morning and six in the evening.
examples.paraphrase: Tamsin's morning reading was six pages, and her evening reading was six as well.

questions.question: How many pages did Tamsin read in total?
Did she read exactly ten pages in all?

examples.source_text: Ursula picked eight cherries from one tree and one from another.
examples.paraphrase: From one tree Ursula picked eight cherries, and from a second she picked just one.

questions.question: How many cherries did Ursula pick in all?
Did she pick more cherries from the first tree?

examples.source_text: Viktor's hens laid four eggs on Monday and four on Tuesday.
examples.paraphrase: Over Monday and Tuesday, Viktor's hens laid four eggs each day.

questions.question: How many eggs did the hens lay over the two days?
Did they lay nine eggs in total?

examples.source_text: Winifred needs seven stamps for letters and three for parcels.
examples.paraphrase: Three stamps are required for Winifred's parcels, and seven for her letters.

questions.question: How many stamps does Winifred need in all?
Does she need more stamps for parcels than for letters?

examples.source_text: A bus held nine riders when two more climbed aboard.
examples.paraphrase: Two additional riders boarded a bus that already carried nine.

questions.question: How many riders are on the bus now?
Are there more than ten riders now?

examples.source_text: Hobart owns three cats and two dogs, and Ewan owns one cat.
examples.paraphrase: Ewan owns one cat; Hobart has two dogs and three cats.

questions.question: How many cats do Hobart and Ewan own in all?
Do Hobart and Ewan own six animals together?

examples.source_text: Ronan lent a scooter to Brisa, and Brisa lent it to Hobart.
examples.paraphrase: Hobart borrowed from Brisa the scooter that Ronan had lent her.

questions.question: Does Ronan have the scooter now?

examples.source_text: Ansel gave Greta a telescope, then Greta returned it to Ansel.
examples.paraphrase: Greta handed the telescope back to Ansel after receiving it from him.

questions.question: Does Ansel have the telescope now?

examples.source_text: Lucan sold an accordion to Odalys, who later swapped it with Perrin for a kite.
examples.paraphrase: After buying an accordion from Lucan, Odalys exchanged it with Perrin and got a kite in return.

examples.source_text: Thaddeus left an umbrella with Ulrik. Ulrik passed it to Vesna, who gave it back to Thaddeus.
examples.paraphrase: The umbrella went from Thaddeus to Ulrik, then to Vesna, and finally returned to Thaddeus.

questions.question: Does Vesna have the umbrella now?

examples.source_text: Xavi lent his raincoat to Yarrow. Yarrow kept it until Zephyr asked and received it.
examples.paraphrase: Zephyr asked Yarrow for the raincoat that Xavi had lent to Yarrow, and got it.

questions.question: Does Zephyr have the raincoat now?

examples.source_text: Beatrix received a canoe from Caspar and sold it to Dorian for ten dollars.
examples.paraphrase: Dorian bought for ten dollars a canoe that Beatrix had got from Caspar.

questions.question: Did Beatrix sell the canoe to Dorian?

examples.source_text: Kestrel gave Leopold a sled, but Leopold passed it straight on to Mirela.
examples.paraphrase: Mirela ended up with the sled that Kestrel had given Leopold, who passed it on at once.

questions.question: Who has the sled in the end?
Did Leopold give the sled to Mirela?

examples.source_text: Nadine lent Osric a banjo, and he lent it to Petra. Petra later returned it to Nadine.
examples.paraphrase: Osric lent Petra the banjo he had borrowed from Nadine; Petra later gave it back to Nadine.

questions.question: Did Nadine lend the banjo to Petra?

examples.source_text: At the fair, Hobart was photographed by Ronan.
examples.paraphrase: At the fair, Ronan photographed Hobart.

examples.source_text: Fenwick was rescued by Marguerite after the boat tipped.
examples.paraphrase: After the boat tipped, Marguerite rescued Fenwick.

examples.source_text: Tobias was taught chess by Ingrid, and Ingrid was taught chess by Cormac.
examples.paraphrase: Cormac taught Ingrid chess, and she taught Tobias.

examples.source_text: Delphine was invited to the party by Ansel, but Greta was not invited by him.
examples.paraphrase: Ansel invited Delphine to the party; Greta did not get an invitation from him.

examples.source_text: Lucan was greeted by Odalys, and Odalys was followed by Perrin.
examples.paraphrase: Odalys greeted Lucan, and Perrin followed Odalys.

examples.source_text: The letter was written by Ulrik and read aloud by Vesna.
examples.paraphrase: Ulrik wrote the letter, and Vesna read it aloud.

examples.source_text: The cake was baked by Yarrow and eaten by Zephyr.
examples.paraphrase: Yarrow baked the cake, which Zephyr ate.

examples.source_text: Beatrix was warned by Caspar, who had been warned by Dorian.
examples.paraphrase: Dorian warned Caspar, and Caspar warned Beatrix.

examples.source_text: Only Elspeth brought a tent to the campsite.
examples.paraphrase: Nobody except Elspeth brought a tent to the campsite.

examples.source_text: The choir was Gideon, Hester and Ewan; all but Gideon wore a sash.
examples.paraphrase: Gideon was the only choir member without a sash; Hester and Ewan wore one.

questions.question: Who did not wear a sash?

examples.source_text: Nadine, Osric and Petra all entered the race, but only Osric finished.
examples.paraphrase: All three of Nadine, Osric and Petra entered the race, yet Osric alone crossed the finish line.

examples.source_text: Selwyn, Tamsin and Rafferty were asked to sing; each except Rafferty agreed.
examples.paraphrase: Selwyn and Tamsin agreed when asked to sing, but Rafferty did not.

examples.source_text: Ursula sold nothing but lemonade at her stall.
examples.paraphrase: Lemonade was the only thing Ursula's stall sold.

questions.question: Did Ursula's stall sell anything besides lemonade?

examples.source_text: The neighbors were Winifred, Xavi and Yarrow; Viktor invited all except Winifred.
examples.paraphrase: Viktor invited Xavi and Yarrow, but not Winifred, the third neighbor.

examples.source_text: Zephyr ate only the crust of the sandwich.
examples.paraphrase: Of the sandwich, Zephyr ate nothing but the crust.

examples.source_text: Caspar fixed every shutter in the house except the one upstairs.
examples.paraphrase: The only shutter in the house that Caspar did not fix was the upstairs one.

questions.question: Which shutter did Caspar not fix?
Did Caspar fix the upstairs shutter?
